description: Use when the user asks what is being tracked or wants to change it. Returns the brand's plan, markets, rivals, Custom topics (the `customNeeds` field: each with its id, its name, the questions Parse asks it as, its source: "Added by you", "Only for" and the brand's name when Parse drafted it for this brand alone, or the market it belongs to, and how many ways it is asked) and the user's own notification switches. Read-only. On Pro, parse_add_question, parse_remove_question, parse_correct_rival and parse_set_notification change one.

brandSlug.description: The brand's slug or its name. Omit it to use the workspace's own brand.
